release_rule: A learner PDF may not release with clipped, overlapping or unreadable text/figure content.

authoring.figure_rule: Figures are isolated layout blocks with explicit bounding boxes. Text must not be hand-positioned into the same free canvas region unless collision checks exist.
authoring.svg_or_vector_labels: Labels must stay within the figure bounding box or dedicated caption area; they may not intrude into headings/body text.

regression_note: The SBA23 pilot exposed heading/figure collisions caused by free-canvas labels. This policy forbids treating successful PDF generation as visual-preflight success.
